case_name: P.D. Aggarwal And Ors. v State Of U.P. And Ors.
facts: The facts giving rise to these writ petitions are in brief as follows: Previously Public Health Department as well as the Irrigation Department of the Government of Uttar Pradesh were integrated into Public Works Department comprising both these two branches. In 1922 Irrigation branch was separated into a different independent department. Similarly, in 1927 Public Health Department was separated. In 1936 U.P. Service of Engineers Class II Rules (Buildings and Roads Branch) pertaining to P.W.D. were framed in exercise of powers conferred under the Government of India Act.
On December 7, 1961 an office memorandum No. 4162 EBR XXIII-PWD-90 EBR 1954 was issued by the Government laying down the principles for recruitment to the permanent and temporary posts.

It has been further provided therein that successful candidates in order of merit will be appointed on probation against vacant permanent posts and those following will be appointed against temporary posts.
Thereafter on 28.7.1969 an amendment to the Rule was made by the Government in exercise of power under proviso to Art. 309 of the Constitution.
issues: What is the correct method of recruitment for Assistant Engineers in the Public Works Department?
How should seniority be determined in the service?
What are the guidelines for filling vacancies in the permanent cadre of the service?
court_reasoning: The relevant provisions of these Rules are quoted herein below: Rule 3: In these rules unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context: (a) The 'Service' means the U.P. Service of Engineers (Buildings and Roads Branch), Class II, ...

Rule 5: Source of recruitment: Recruitment to the post of Assistant Engineer shall be made from the following sources- (a) in permanent vacancies- (i) by direct recruitment on the result of a competitive examination conducted by the Commission; ...

The Governor shall decide the number of appointments to be made at each selection in each kind of post from the sources specified in rule 5: Provided that recruitment in substantive vacancies occurring during a period of recruitment in the post of Assistant Engineer, shall, so far as may be possible, be made from the source mentioned in rule 5(a) in the following proportion: ...
The Court has to decide whether the seniority list prepared on 29.7.1980 and 18.12.1980 with 19.12.1980 is valid or not.
holding: The judgment of the High Court is set aside and the appeals are allowed. The seniority list in question is quashed.
